name: CAD Coin

mintAuthority.summary: CADC is issued by Loon through issuer-controlled owner/masterMinter Safes. All five EVM tokens are upgradeable legacy ZeppelinOS FiatTokenProxy deployments: Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, and Base share a 1-of-1 proxy-admin Safe, while Linea is immediately upgradeable by a single EOA. The Solana mint remains separately owned by the SPL Token program.

controls.label: Loon CADC issuance backend
controls.evidence: Loon controls 1:1 mint on CAD deposit and burn on redemption against segregated trust reserves; minting is issuer-operated with no permissionless route. The issuer-controlled masterMinter Safes can authorize minters and change mint allowances, so this issuer failure domain can raise the effective mint cap.

It can immediately call the verified FiatTokenProxy upgrade functions on the first four deployments.

controls.label: CADC Linea legacy proxy admin EOA
controls.evidence: At Linea block 31369755, the legacy ZeppelinOS admin slot on CADC resolved directly to 0xa0f5c8e8bcbdf066643c2ea8484cba7a3aff01f9 and eth_getCode returned 0x. This single EOA can replace the implementation immediately and is therefore the weakest deployment-wide upgrade authority.

review.evidence: Sourcify verifies all five EVM deployments as FiatTokenProxy/ZeppelinOSProxy contracts whose AdminUpgradeabilityProxy path exposes upgradeTo and upgradeToAndCall. At Ethereum block 25531348, Polygon block 90221803, Arbitrum block 483787112, Base block 48624176, and Linea block 31369755, the legacy implementation slot resolved in contract order to 0x0c9b0169..., 0x82d095da..., 0x30828472..., 0xdd022586..., and 0x8056da37.... The legacy admin slot resolved to 0x616c8314... on the first four chains and 0xa0f5c8e8... on Linea. The shared-address admin is a 1-of-1 Safe on each of the first four chains with sole owner 0x568b35d8..., no modules, and no guard; the Linea admin is an EOA. The previously reviewed logic-level owner/masterMinter Safes remain separate controls. Solana mint 9ewjJpmD... remains owned by the SPL Token program with its distinct mint and freeze authorities and is not included in the EVM proxy arrays. Mint-tier review (2026-07-15): HDCPA Professional Corporation independently attests CADC reserves monthly; the latest archive entry covers June 2026 and was uploaded 2026-07-06, reconciling CADC supply to CAD held at ATB Financial. FINTRAC's registry match for Loon Finance Inc. is an AML/MSB registration, not prudential stablecoin-issuer supervision.

reserveReview.rationale: Loon's current transparency page states that every CADC is backed 1:1 by Canadian dollars at ATB Financial, with 100% cash deposits in segregated accounts and no exposure to commercial paper or investment instruments. The page lists a June 2026 monthly bank attestation, so the single disclosed cash-deposit slice remains the complete reserve composition.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Loon transparency page and listed June 2026 monthly bank attestation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The reserve asset class and ATB Financial custody are disclosed; the transparency page does not disclose account-level balances or provider shares beyond the single named bank.
